newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION - Preston struggling to be fit for NSW.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - Preston struggling to be fit for NSW.

text.p: WELLINGTON, April 30 - Wellington Hurricanes halfback Jon Preston is struggling to be fit for Friday's Super 12 rugby match against New South Wales in Napier, NZPA reports.
All Black Preston could not train yesterday when the Hurricanes gathered in Hastings, and coach Frank Oliver will give him until late on Friday to prove his fitness.

As backline controller and goalkicker, Preston will be a critical figure in Friday's match, especially as it appears -- on paper at least -- to be the Hurricanes' best chance of qualifying for the semifinals.
A loss on Friday would mean the Hurricanes would have to beat either of the top two teams, Auckland or ACT, to qualify.
There was good news, though, with big lock Mark Cooksley easily getting through a tough scrum and tackling session after injuring his neck against Otago on Saturday.
"There is some doubt about JP (Preston) playing," Oliver said.
"We thought initially that his calf muscle problem was just a niggly one, but it might be worse than that -- maybe a four out of 10, rather than a two.
"I don't want to put any pressure on him to train this week and I'll give him every chance."
Taranaki's Richard Jarman will play if Preston is unfit.
The other problem area, at centre, has been placed in the hands of Mark Ranby, with Tana Umaga being left on the right wing.
"Ranby did some very good things when he came on for Alama Ieremia on Sunday," Oliver added.

Wellington Hurricanes: Christian Cullen, Alex Telea, Mark Ranby, Tana Umaga, Jason O'Halloran, Stephen Bachop, Jon Preston, Filo Tiatia, Martin Leslie, Mike Russell, Mark Cooksley, Chresten Davis, Phil Coffin, Norman Hewitt, Mark Allen (captain).
Reserves: Richard Jarman, Jarrod Cunningham, Tala Leiasamaivao, Bill Cavubati, Finau Maka, Kevin Barrett.

New South Wales: Matthew Burke, Chris Latham, Jason Madz, Matt Dixon, David Campese, Scott Bowen, Sam Payne, Fili Finau, Stu Pinkerton, John Welborn, Tim Gavin (captain), Michael Brial, Andrew Heath, Phil Kearns, Cameron Blades.
